L.7er: ^101:29^ Fílii servórum tuórum habitábunt: * et semen eórum in sǽculum dirigétur.
L.7eu: ^101:2^ Hear, O Lord, my prayer: * and let my cry come to thee.
L.7ey: ^101:3^ Turn not away thy face from me: * in the day when I am in trouble, incline thy ear to me.
L.7ew: ^101:3^ In what day soever I shall call upon thee, * hear me speedily.
L.7ez: ^101:4^ For my days are vanished like smoke: * and my bones are grown dry like fuel for the fire.
L.7f1: ^101:5^ I am smitten as grass, and my heart is withered: * because I forgot to eat my bread.
L.7f4: ^101:6^ Through the voice of my groaning, * my bone hath cleaved to my flesh.
L.7f5: ^101:7^ I am become like to a pelican of the wilderness: * I am like a night raven in the house.
L.7f7: ^101:8^ I have watched, * and am become as a sparrow all alone on the housetop.
L.7f9: ^101:9^ All the day long my enemies reproached me: * and they that praised me did swear against me.
L.7dp: ^101:10^ For I did eat ashes like bread, * and mingled my drink with weeping.
L.7ds: ^101:11^ Because of thy anger and indignation: * for having lifted me up thou hast thrown me down.
L.7du: ^101:12^ My days have declined like a shadow, * and I am withered like grass.
L.7dv: ^101:13^ But thou, O Lord, endurest for ever: * and thy memorial to all generations.
L.7dx: ^101:14^ Thou shalt arise and have mercy on Sion: * for it is time to have mercy on it, for the time is come.
L.7dz: ^101:15^ For the stones thereof have pleased thy servants: * and they shall have pity on the earth thereof.
L.7e1: ^101:16^ And the Gentiles shall fear thy name, O Lord, * and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
L.7e3: ^101:17^ For the Lord hath built up Sion: * and he shall be seen in his glory.
L.7e5: ^101:18^ He hath had regard to the prayer of the humble: * and he hath not despised their petition.
L.7e7: ^101:19^ Let these things be written unto another generation: * and the people that shall be created shall praise the Lord:
L.7e9: ^101:20^ Because he hath looked forth from his high sanctuary: * from heaven the Lord hath looked upon the earth.
L.7eb: ^101:21^ That he might hear the groans of them that are in fetters: * that he might release the children of the slain:
L.7ed: ^101:22^ That they may declare the name of the Lord in Sion: * and his praise in Jerusalem;
L.7eg: ^101:23^ When the people assemble together, * and kings, to serve the Lord.
L.7eh: ^101:24^ He answered him in the way of his strength: * Declare unto me the fewness of my days.
L.7ej: ^101:25^ Call me not away in the midst of my days: * thy years are unto generation and generation.
L.7el: ^101:26^ In the beginning, O Lord, thou foundedst the earth: * and the heavens are the works of thy hands.
L.7eo: ^101:27^ They shall perish but thou remainest: * and all of them shall grow old like a garment:
L.7ep: ^101:28^ And as a vesture thou shalt change them, and they shall be changed. * But thou art always the selfsame, and thy years shall not fail.
L.7es: ^101:29^ The children of thy servants shall continue: * and their seed shall be directed for ever.
L.xu6: ^Ant.^ Clamor meus ad te véniat Deus.
L.yyx: ^Ant.^ O God, let my cry come unto Thee.
L.rkq: ^103:1^ Bénedic, ^‡^ ánima mea, Dómino: * Dómine, Deus meus, magnificátus es veheménter.
L.rkp: ^103:1^ Bless the Lord, ^‡^ O my soul: * O Lord my God, thou art exceedingly great.
L.7fv: ^104:1^ Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus: * annuntiáte inter gentes ópera ejus.
L.7gf: ^104:2^ Cantáte ei, et psállite ei: * narráte ómnia mirabília ejus.
L.7h2: ^104:3^ Laudámini in nómine sancto ejus: * lætétur cor quæréntium Dóminum.
L.7hf: ^104:4^ Quǽrite Dóminum, et confirmámini: * quǽrite fáciem ejus semper.
L.7hh: ^104:5^ Mementóte mirabílium ejus, quæ fecit: * prodígia ejus, et judícia oris ejus.
L.7hk: ^104:6^ Semen Ábraham, servi ejus: * fílii Jacob, elécti ejus.
L.7hm: ^104:7^ Ipse Dóminus Deus noster: * in univérsa terra judícia ejus.
L.7ho: ^104:8^ Memor fuit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * verbi, quod mandávit in mille generatiónes:
L.7hp: ^104:9^ Quod dispósuit ad Ábraham: * et juraménti sui ad Isaac:
L.7fc: ^104:10^ Et státuit illud Jacob in præcéptum: * et Israël in testaméntum ætérnum:
L.7fd: ^104:11^ Dicens: Tibi dabo terram Chánaan, * funículum hereditátis vestræ.
L.7ff: ^104:12^ Cum essent número brevi, * paucíssimi et íncolæ ejus:
L.7fi: ^104:13^ Et pertransiérunt de gente in gentem, * et de regno ad pópulum álterum.
L.7fk: ^104:14^ Non relíquit hóminem nocére eis: * et corrípuit pro eis reges.
L.7fl: ^104:15^ Nolíte tángere christos meos: * et in prophétis meis nolíte malignári.
L.7fo: ^104:16^ Et vocávit famem super terram: * et omne firmaméntum panis contrívit.
L.7fq: ^104:17^ Misit ante eos virum: * in servum venúmdatus est Joseph.
L.7fr: ^104:18^ Humiliavérunt in compédibus pedes ejus, ferrum pertránsiit ánimam ejus * donec veníret verbum ejus.
L.7ft: ^104:19^ Elóquium Dómini inflammávit eum: * misit rex, et solvit eum; princeps populórum, et dimísit eum.
L.7fx: ^104:21^ Constítuit eum dóminum domus suæ: * et príncipem omnis possessiónis suæ:
L.7g0: ^104:22^ Ut erudíret príncipes ejus sicut semetípsum: * et senes ejus prudéntiam docéret.
L.7g2: ^104:23^ Et intrávit Israël in Ægýptum: * et Jacob áccola fuit in terra Cham.
L.7g4: ^104:24^ Et auxit pópulum suum veheménter: * et firmávit eum super inimícos ejus.
L.7g5: ^104:25^ Convértit cor eórum ut odírent pópulum ejus: * et dolum fácerent in servos ejus.
L.7g8: ^104:26^ Misit Móysen, servum suum: * Aaron, quem elégit ipsum.
L.7ga: ^104:27^ Pósuit in eis verba signórum suórum: * et prodigiórum in terra Cham.
L.7gc: ^104:28^ Misit ténebras, et obscurávit: * et non exacerbávit sermónes suos.
L.7gd: ^104:29^ Convértit aquas eórum in sánguinem: * et occídit pisces eórum.
L.7gi: ^104:30^ Édidit terra eórum ranas: * in penetrálibus regum ipsórum.
L.7gj: ^104:31^ Dixit, et venit cœnomyía: * et cínifes in ómnibus fínibus eórum.
L.7gm: ^104:32^ Pósuit plúvias eórum grándinem: * ignem comburéntem in terra ipsórum.
L.7go: ^104:33^ Et percússit víneas eórum, et ficúlneas eórum: * et contrívit lignum fínium eórum.
L.7gp: ^104:34^ Dixit, et venit locústa, et bruchus, * cujus non erat númerus:
L.7gs: ^104:35^ Et comédit omne fænum in terra eórum: * et comédit omnem fructum terræ eórum.
L.7gu: ^104:36^ Et percússit omne primogénitum in terra eórum: * primítias omnis labóris eórum.
L.7gw: ^104:37^ Et edúxit eos cum argénto et auro: * et non erat in tríbubus eórum infírmus.
L.7gy: ^104:38^ Lætáta est Ægýptus in profectióne eórum: * quia incúbuit timor eórum super eos.
L.7gz: ^104:39^ Expándit nubem in protectiónem eórum: * et ignem ut lucéret eis per noctem.
L.7h3: ^104:40^ Petiérunt, et venit cotúrnix: * et pane cæli saturávit eos.
L.7h5: ^104:41^ Dirúpit petram et fluxérunt aquæ: * abiérunt in sicco flúmina;
L.7h8: ^104:42^ Quóniam memor fuit verbi sancti sui: * quod hábuit ad Ábraham, púerum suum.
L.7ha: ^104:43^ Et edúxit pópulum suum in exsultatióne, * et eléctos suos in lætítia.
L.7hc: ^104:44^ Et dedit illis regiónes géntium: * et labóres populórum possedérunt:
L.7he: ^104:45^ Ut custódiant justificatiónes ejus, * et legem ejus requírant.
L.7fw: ^104:1^ Give glory to the Lord, and call upon his name: * declare his deeds among the Gentiles.
L.7gg: ^104:2^ Sing to him, yea sing praises to him: * relate all his wondrous works.
L.7h1: ^104:3^ Glory ye in his holy name: * let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
L.7hg: ^104:4^ Seek ye the Lord, and be strengthened: * seek his face evermore.
L.7hi: ^104:5^ Remember his marvellous works which he hath done; * his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth.
L.7hj: ^104:6^ O ye seed of Abraham his servant; * ye sons of Jacob his chosen.
L.7hl: ^104:7^ He is the Lord our God: * his judgments are in all the earth.
L.7hn: ^104:8^ He hath remembered his covenant for ever: * the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.
L.7hq: ^104:9^ Which he made to Abraham; * and his oath to Isaac:
L.7fb: ^104:10^ And he appointed the same to Jacob for a law, * and to Israel for an everlasting testament:
L.7fe: ^104:11^ Saying: To thee will I give the land of Chanaan, * the lot of your inheritance.
L.7fg: ^104:12^ When they were but a small number: * yea very few, and sojourners therein:
L.7fh: ^104:13^ And they passed from nation to nation, * and from one kingdom to another people.
L.7fj: ^104:14^ He suffered no man to hurt them: * and he reproved kings for their sakes.
L.7fm: ^104:15^ Touch ye not my anointed: * and do no evil to my prophets.
L.7fn: ^104:16^ And he called a famine upon the land: * and he broke in pieces all the support of bread.
L.7fp: ^104:17^ He sent a man before them: * Joseph, who was sold for a slave.
L.7fs: ^104:18^ They humbled his feet in fetters: the iron pierced his soul, * until his word came.
L.7fu: ^104:19^ The word of the Lord inflamed him: * the king sent, and he released him: the ruler of the people, and he set him at liberty.
L.7fy: ^104:21^ He made him master of his house, * and ruler of all his possession.
L.7fz: ^104:22^ That he might instruct his princes as himself, * and teach his ancients wisdom.
L.7g1: ^104:23^ And Israel went into Egypt: * and Jacob was a sojourner in the land of Cham.
L.7g3: ^104:24^ And he increased his people exceedingly: * and strengthened them over their enemies,
L.7g6: ^104:25^ He turned their heart to hate his people: * and to deal deceitfully with his servants.
L.7g7: ^104:26^ He sent Moses his servant: * Aaron the man whom he had chosen.
L.7g9: ^104:27^ He gave them power to shew his signs, * and his wonders in the land of Cham.
L.7gb: ^104:28^ He sent darkness, and made it obscure: * and grieved not his words.
L.7ge: ^104:29^ He turned their waters into blood, * and destroyed their fish.
L.7gh: ^104:30^ Their land brought forth frogs, * in the inner chambers of their kings.
L.7gk: ^104:31^ He spoke, and there came diverse sorts of flies, * and sciniphs in all their coasts.
L.7gl: ^104:32^ He gave them hail for rain, * a burning fire in the land.
L.7gn: ^104:33^ And he destroyed their vineyards, and their fig trees: * and he broke in pieces the trees of their coasts.
L.7gq: ^104:34^ He spoke, and the locust came, and the bruchus, * of which there was no number.
L.7gr: ^104:35^ And they devoured all the grass in their land, * and consumed all the fruit of their ground.
L.7gt: ^104:36^ And he slew all the firstborn in their land: * the firstfruits of all their labour.
L.7gv: ^104:37^ And he brought them out with silver and gold: * and there was not among their tribes one that was feeble.
L.7gx: ^104:38^ Egypt was glad when they departed: * for the fear of them lay upon them.
L.7h0: ^104:39^ He spread a cloud for their protection, * and fire to give them light in the night.
L.7h4: ^104:40^ They asked, and the quail came: * and he filled them with the bread of heaven.
L.7h6: ^104:41^ He opened the rock, and waters flowed: * rivers ran down in the dry land.
L.7h7: ^104:42^ Because he remembered his holy word, * which he had spoken to his servant Abraham.
L.7h9: ^104:43^ And he brought forth his people with joy, * and his chosen with gladness.
L.7hb: ^104:44^ And he gave them the lands of the Gentiles: * and they possessed the labours of the people:
L.7hd: ^104:45^ That they might observe his justifications, * and seek after his law.
L.xrh: ^Ant.^ Bless the Lord, O my soul.
L.7ib: ^105:1^ Confitémini Dómino, quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
L.7iv: ^105:2^ Quis loquétur poténtias Dómini, * audítas fáciet omnes laudes ejus?
L.7jd: ^105:3^ Beáti, qui custódiunt judícium, * et fáciunt justítiam in omni témpore.
L.7jz: ^105:4^ Meménto nostri, Dómine, in beneplácito pópuli tui: * vísita nos in salutári tuo:
L.7k1: ^105:5^ Ad vidéndum in bonitáte electórum tuórum, ad lætándum in lætítia gentis tuæ: * ut laudéris cum hereditáte tua.
L.7k3: ^105:6^ Peccávimus cum pátribus nostris: * injúste égimus, iniquitátem fécimus.
L.7k8: ^105:7^ Patres nostri in Ægýpto non intellexérunt mirabília tua: * non fuérunt mémores multitúdinis misericórdiæ tuæ.
L.7k6: ^105:7^ Et irritavérunt ascendéntes in mare, * Mare Rubrum.
L.7ka: ^105:8^ Et salvávit eos propter nomen suum: * ut notam fáceret poténtiam suam.
L.7kc: ^105:9^ Et incrépuit Mare Rubrum, et exsiccátum est, * et dedúxit eos in abýssis sicut in desérto.
L.7hs: ^105:10^ Et salvávit eos de manu odiéntium: * et redémit eos de manu inimíci.
L.7hu: ^105:11^ Et opéruit aqua tribulántes eos: * unus ex eis non remánsit.
L.7hw: ^105:12^ Et credidérunt verbis ejus: * et laudavérunt laudem ejus.
L.7hx: ^105:13^ Cito fecérunt, oblíti sunt óperum ejus: * et non sustinuérunt consílium ejus.
L.7i0: ^105:14^ Et concupiérunt concupiscéntiam in desérto: * et tentavérunt Deum in inaquóso.
L.7i2: ^105:15^ Et dedit eis petitiónem ipsórum: * et misit saturitátem in ánimas eórum.
L.7i4: ^105:16^ Et irritavérunt Móysen in castris: * Aaron, sanctum Dómini.
L.7i5: ^105:17^ Apérta est terra, et deglutívit Dathan: * et opéruit super congregatiónem Abíron.
L.7i8: ^105:18^ Et exársit ignis in synagóga eórum * flamma combússit peccatóres.
L.7i9: ^105:19^ Et fecérunt vítulum in Horeb * et adoravérunt scúlptile.
L.7ie: ^105:20^ Et mutavérunt glóriam suam * in similitúdinem vítuli comedéntis fænum.
L.7if: ^105:21^ Oblíti sunt Deum, qui salvávit eos, * qui fecit magnália in Ægýpto, mirabília in terra Cham: terribília in Mari Rubro.
L.7ii: ^105:23^ Et dixit ut dispérderet eos: * si non Móyses, eléctus ejus, stetísset in confractióne in conspéctu ejus:
L.7ik: ^105:24^ Ut avérteret iram ejus ne dispérderet eos: * et pro níhilo habuérunt terram desiderábilem:
L.7il: ^105:25^ Non credidérunt verbo ejus, et murmuravérunt in tabernáculis suis: * non exaudiérunt vocem Dómini.
L.7io: ^105:26^ Et elevávit manum suam super eos: * ut prostérneret eos in desérto:
L.7iq: ^105:27^ Et ut deíceret semen eórum in natiónibus: * et dispérgeret eos in regiónibus.
L.7ir: ^105:28^ Et initiáti sunt Beélphegor: * et comedérunt sacrifícia mortuórum.
L.7iu: ^105:29^ Et irritavérunt eum in adinventiónibus suis: * et multiplicáta est in eis ruína.
L.7ix: ^105:30^ Et stetit Phínees, et placávit: * et cessávit quassátio.
L.7j0: ^105:31^ Et reputátum est ei in justítiam: * in generatiónem et generatiónem usque in sempitérnum.
L.7j1: ^105:32^ Et irritavérunt eum ad aquas contradictiónis: * et vexátus est Móyses propter eos: quia exacerbavérunt spíritum ejus.
L.7j4: ^105:33^ Et distínxit in lábiis suis: * non disperdidérunt gentes, quas dixit Dóminus illis.
L.7j6: ^105:35^ Et commísti sunt inter gentes, et didicérunt ópera eórum: et serviérunt sculptílibus eórum: * et factum est illis in scándalum.
L.7j8: ^105:37^ Et immolavérunt fílios suos, * et fílias suas dæmóniis.
L.7ja: ^105:38^ Et effudérunt sánguinem innocéntem: * sánguinem filiórum suórum et filiárum suárum, quas sacrificavérunt sculptílibus Chánaan.
L.7jc: ^105:39^ Et infécta est terra in sanguínibus, et contamináta est in opéribus eórum: * et fornicáti sunt in adinventiónibus suis.
L.7jg: ^105:40^ Et irátus est furóre Dóminus in pópulum suum: * et abominátus est hereditátem suam.
L.7ji: ^105:41^ Et trádidit eos in manus géntium: * et domináti sunt eórum qui odérunt eos.
L.7jk: ^105:42^ Et tribulavérunt eos inimíci eórum, et humiliáti sunt sub mánibus eórum: * sæpe liberávit eos.
L.7jm: ^105:43^ Ipsi autem exacerbavérunt eum in consílio suo: * et humiliáti sunt in iniquitátibus suis.
L.7jo: ^105:44^ Et vidit, cum tribularéntur: * et audívit oratiónem eórum.
L.7jq: ^105:45^ Et memor fuit testaménti sui: * et pœnítuit eum secúndum multitúdinem misericórdiæ suæ.
L.7js: ^105:46^ Et dedit eos in misericórdias * in conspéctu ómnium qui céperant eos.
L.7jt: ^105:47^ Salvos nos fac, Dómine, Deus noster: * et cóngrega nos de natiónibus:
L.7jw: ^105:47^ Ut confiteámur nómini sancto tuo: * et gloriémur in laude tua.
L.7jx: ^105:48^ Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus Israël, a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum: * et dicet omnis pópulus: Fiat, fiat.
L.7ic: ^105:1^ Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.
L.7iw: ^105:2^ Who shall declare the powers of the Lord? * who shall set forth all his praises?
L.7je: ^105:3^ Blessed are they that keep judgment, * and do justice at all times.
L.7k0: ^105:4^ Remember us, O Lord, in the favour of thy people: * visit us with thy salvation.
L.7k2: ^105:5^ That we may see the good of thy chosen, that we may rejoice in the joy of thy nation: * that thou mayst be praised with thy inheritance.
L.7k4: ^105:6^ We have sinned with our fathers: * we have acted unjustly, we have wrought iniquity.
L.7k7: ^105:7^ Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt: * they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies:
L.7k5: ^105:7^ And they provoked to wrath going up to the sea, * even the Red Sea.
L.7k9: ^105:8^ And he saved them for his own name’s sake: * that he might make his power known.
L.7kb: ^105:9^ And he rebuked the Red Sea, and it was dried up: * and he led them through the depths, as in a wilderness.
L.7hr: ^105:10^ And he saved them from the hand of them that hated them: * and he redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
L.7ht: ^105:11^ And the water covered them that afflicted them: * there was not one of them left.
L.7hv: ^105:12^ And they believed his words: * and they sang his praises.
L.7hy: ^105:13^ They had quickly done, they forgot his works: * and they waited not for his counsels.
L.7hz: ^105:14^ And they coveted their desire in the desert: * and they tempted God in the place without water.
L.7i1: ^105:15^ And he gave them their request: * and sent fulness into their souls.
L.7i3: ^105:16^ And they provoked Moses in the camp, * Aaron the holy one of the Lord.
L.7i6: ^105:17^ The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan: * and covered the congregation of Abiron.
L.7i7: ^105:18^ And a fire was kindled in their congregation: * the flame burned the wicked.
L.7ia: ^105:19^ They made also a calf in Horeb: * and they adored the graven thing.
L.7id: ^105:20^ And they changed their glory * into the likeness of a calf that eateth grass.
L.7ig: ^105:21^ They forgot God, who saved them, * who had done great things in Egypt, wondrous works in the land of Cham: terrible things in the Red Sea.
L.7ih: ^105:23^ And he said that he would destroy them: * had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach:
L.7ij: ^105:24^ To turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them; * and they set at nought the desirable land.
L.7im: ^105:25^ They believed not his word, and they murmured in their tents: * they hearkened not to the voice of the Lord.
L.7in: ^105:26^ And he lifted up his hand over them: * to overthrow them in the desert;
L.7ip: ^105:27^ And to cast down their seed among the nations, * and to scatter them in the countries.
L.7is: ^105:28^ They also were initiated to Beelphegor: * and ate the sacrifices of the dead.
L.7it: ^105:29^ And they provoked him with their inventions: * and destruction was multiplied among them.
L.7iy: ^105:30^ Then Phinees stood up, and pacified him: * and the slaughter ceased.
L.7iz: ^105:31^ And it was reputed to him unto justice, * to generation and generation for evermore.
L.7j2: ^105:32^ They provoked him also at the waters of contradiction: * and Moses was afflicted for their sakes: because they exasperated his spirit.
L.7j3: ^105:33^ And he distinguished with his lips; * they did not destroy the nations of which the Lord spoke unto them.
L.7j5: ^105:35^ And they were mingled among the heathens, and learned their works: and served their idols, * and it became a stumblingblock to them.
L.7j7: ^105:37^ And they sacrificed their sons, * and their daughters to devils.
L.7j9: ^105:38^ And they shed innocent blood: * the blood of their sons and of their daughters which they sacrificed to the idols of Chanaan.
L.7jb: ^105:39^ And the land was polluted with blood, and was defiled with their works: * and they went aside after their own inventions.
L.7jf: ^105:40^ And the Lord was exceedingly angry with his people: * and he abhorred his inheritance.
L.7jh: ^105:41^ And he delivered them into the hands of the nations: * and they that hated them had dominion over them.
L.7jj: ^105:42^ And their enemies afflicted them: and they were humbled under their hands: * many times did he deliver them.
L.7jl: ^105:43^ But they provoked him with their counsel: * and they were brought low by their iniquities.
L.7jn: ^105:44^ And he saw when they were in tribulation: * and he heard their prayer.
L.7jp: ^105:45^ And he was mindful of his covenant: * and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.
L.7jr: ^105:46^ And he gave them unto mercies, * in the sight of all those that had made them captives.
L.7ju: ^105:47^ Save us, O Lord, our God: * and gather us from among nations:
L.7jv: ^105:47^ That we may give thanks to thy holy name, * and may glory in thy praise.
L.7jy: ^105:48^ Blessed be the Lord the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting: * and let all the people say: So be it, so be it.
L.7kx: ^106:1^ Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
L.7lj: ^106:2^ Dicant qui redémpti sunt a Dómino, quos redémit de manu inimíci: * et de regiónibus congregávit eos:
L.7m5: ^106:3^ A solis ortu, et occásu: * ab aquilóne, et mari.
L.7mf: ^106:4^ Erravérunt in solitúdine in inaquóso: * viam civitátis habitáculi non invenérunt.
L.7mh: ^106:5^ Esuriéntes, et sitiéntes: * ánima eórum in ipsis defécit.
L.7mk: ^106:6^ Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum erípuit eos.
L.7mm: ^106:7^ Et dedúxit eos in viam rectam: * ut irent in civitátem habitatiónis.
L.7mn: ^106:8^ Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
L.7mq: ^106:9^ Quia satiávit ánimam inánem: * et ánimam esuriéntem satiávit bonis.
L.7kd: ^106:10^ Sedéntes in ténebris, et umbra mortis: * vinctos in mendicitáte et ferro.
L.7kg: ^106:11^ Quia exacerbavérunt elóquia Dei: * et consílium Altíssimi irritavérunt.
L.7ki: ^106:12^ Et humiliátum est in labóribus cor eórum: * infirmáti sunt, nec fuit qui adjuváret.
L.7kj: ^106:13^ Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
L.7km: ^106:14^ Et edúxit eos de ténebris, et umbra mortis: * et víncula eórum disrúpit.
L.7kn: ^106:15^ Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
L.7kq: ^106:16^ Quia contrívit portas ǽreas: * et vectes férreos confrégit.
L.7ks: ^106:17^ Suscépit eos de via iniquitátis eórum: * propter injustítias enim suas humiliáti sunt.
L.7kt: ^106:18^ Omnem escam abomináta est ánima eórum: * et appropinquavérunt usque ad portas mortis.
L.7kw: ^106:19^ Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum liberávit eos.
L.7l0: ^106:20^ Misit verbum suum, et sanávit eos: * et erípuit eos de interitiónibus eórum.
L.7l1: ^106:21^ Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
L.7l4: ^106:22^ Et sacríficent sacrifícium laudis: * et annúntient ópera ejus in exsultatióne.
L.7l5: ^106:23^ Qui descéndunt mare in návibus, * faciéntes operatiónem in aquis multis.
L.7l7: ^106:24^ Ipsi vidérunt ópera Dómini, * et mirabília ejus in profúndo.
L.7l9: ^106:25^ Dixit, et stetit spíritus procéllæ: * et exaltáti sunt fluctus ejus.
L.7lb: ^106:26^ Ascéndunt usque ad cælos, et descéndunt usque ad abýssos: * ánima eórum in malis tabescébat.
L.7le: ^106:27^ Turbáti sunt, et moti sunt sicut ébrius: * et omnis sapiéntia eórum devoráta est.
L.7lg: ^106:28^ Et clamavérunt ad Dóminum cum tribularéntur: * et de necessitátibus eórum edúxit eos.
L.7li: ^106:29^ Et státuit procéllam ejus in auram: * et siluérunt fluctus ejus.
L.7lm: ^106:30^ Et lætáti sunt quia siluérunt: * et dedúxit eos in portum voluntátis eórum.
L.7ln: ^106:31^ Confiteántur Dómino misericórdiæ ejus: * et mirabília ejus fíliis hóminum.
L.7lq: ^106:32^ Et exáltent eum in ecclésia plebis: * et in cáthedra seniórum laudent eum.
L.7ls: ^106:33^ Pósuit flúmina in desértum: * et éxitus aquárum in sitim.
L.7lu: ^106:34^ Terram fructíferam in salsúginem: * a malítia inhabitántium in ea.
L.7lw: ^106:35^ Pósuit desértum in stagna aquárum: * et terram sine aqua in éxitus aquárum.
L.7ly: ^106:36^ Et collocávit illic esuriéntes: * et constituérunt civitátem habitatiónis.
L.7m0: ^106:37^ Et seminavérunt agros, et plantavérunt víneas: * et fecérunt fructum nativitátis.
L.7m2: ^106:38^ Et benedíxit eis, et multiplicáti sunt nimis: * et juménta eórum non minorávit.
L.7m3: ^106:39^ Et pauci facti sunt: * et vexáti sunt a tribulatióne malórum, et dolóre.
L.7m8: ^106:40^ Effúsa est contémptio super príncipes: * et erráre fecit eos in ínvio, et non in via.
L.7ma: ^106:41^ Et adjúvit páuperem de inópia: * et pósuit sicut oves famílias.
L.7mc: ^106:42^ Vidébunt recti, et lætabúntur: * et omnis iníquitas oppilábit os suum.
L.7md: ^106:43^ Quis sápiens et custódiet hæc? * et intélleget misericórdias Dómini.
L.zzk: ^Ant.^ Vísita nos Dómine in salutári tuo.
L.7ky: ^106:1^ Give glory to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.
L.7lk: ^106:2^ Let them say so that have been redeemed by the Lord, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy: * and gathered out of the countries.
L.7m6: ^106:3^ From the rising and the setting of the sun, * from the north and from the sea.
L.7mg: ^106:4^ They wandered in a wilderness, in a place without water: * they found not the way of a city for their habitation.
L.7mi: ^106:5^ They were hungry and thirsty: * their soul fainted in them.
L.7mj: ^106:6^ And they cried to the Lord in their tribulation: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.
L.7ml: ^106:7^ And he led them into the right way: * that they might go to a city of habitation.
L.7mo: ^106:8^ Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.
L.7mp: ^106:9^ For he hath satisfied the empty soul, * and hath filled the hungry soul with good things.
L.7ke: ^106:10^ Such as sat in darkness and in the shadow of death: * bound in want and in iron.
L.7kf: ^106:11^ Because they had exasperated the words of God: * and provoked the counsel of the most High:
L.7kh: ^106:12^ And their heart was humbled with labours: * they were weakened, and there was none to help them.
L.7kk: ^106:13^ Then they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.
L.7kl: ^106:14^ And he brought them out of darkness, * and the shadow of death; and broke their bonds in sunder.
L.7ko: ^106:15^ Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.
L.7kp: ^106:16^ Because he hath broken gates of brass, * and burst the iron bars.
L.7kr: ^106:17^ He took them out of the way of their iniquity: * for they were brought low for their injustices.
L.7ku: ^106:18^ Their soul abhorred all manner of meat: * and they drew nigh even to the gates of death.
L.7kv: ^106:19^ And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he delivered them out of their distresses.
L.7kz: ^106:20^ He sent his word, and healed them: * and delivered them from their destructions.
L.7l2: ^106:21^ Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him: * and his wonderful works to the children of men.
L.7l3: ^106:22^ And let them sacrifice the sacrifice of praise: * and declare his works with joy.
L.7l6: ^106:23^ They that go down to the sea in ships, * doing business in the great waters:
L.7l8: ^106:24^ These have seen the works of the Lord, * and his wonders in the deep.
L.7la: ^106:25^ He said the word, and there arose a storm of wind: * and the waves thereof were lifted up.
L.7lc: ^106:26^ They mount up to the heavens, and they go down to the depths: * their soul pined away with evils.
L.7ld: ^106:27^ They were troubled, and reeled like a drunken man; * and all their wisdom was swallowed up.
L.7lf: ^106:28^ And they cried to the Lord in their affliction: * and he brought them out of their distresses.
L.7lh: ^106:29^ And he turned the storm into a breeze: * and its waves were still.
L.7ll: ^106:30^ And they rejoiced because they were still: * and he brought them to the haven which they wished for.
L.7lo: ^106:31^ Let the mercies of the Lord give glory to him, * and his wonderful works to the children of men.
L.7lp: ^106:32^ And let them exalt him in the church of the people: * and praise him in the chair of the ancients.
L.7lr: ^106:33^ He hath turned rivers into a wilderness: * and the sources of water into dry ground:
L.7lt: ^106:34^ A fruitful land into barrenness, * for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.
L.7lv: ^106:35^ He hath turned a wilderness into pools of water, * and a dry land into water springs.
L.7lx: ^106:36^ And hath placed there the hungry; * and they made a city for their habitation.
L.7lz: ^106:37^ And they sowed fields, and planted vineyards: * and they yielded fruit of birth.
L.7m1: ^106:38^ And he blessed them, and they were multiplied exceedingly: * and their cattle he suffered not to decrease.
L.7m4: ^106:39^ Then they were brought to be few: * and they were afflicted through the trouble of evils and sorrow.
L.7m7: ^106:40^ Contempt was poured forth upon their princes: * and he caused them to wander where there was no passing, and out of the way.
L.7m9: ^106:41^ And he helped the poor out of poverty: * and made him families like a flock of sheep.
L.7mb: ^106:42^ The just shall see, and shall rejoice, * and all iniquity shall stop their mouth.
L.7me: ^106:43^ Who is wise, and will keep these things: * and will understand the mercies of the Lord?
L.zyu: ^Ant.^ Visit us with Thy salvation, O Lord.
L.7n4: ^107:2^ Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psallam in glória mea.
L.7n6: ^107:3^ Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
L.7n7: ^107:4^ Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psallam tibi in natiónibus.
L.7na: ^107:5^ Quia magna est super cælos misericórdia tua: * et usque ad nubes véritas tua:
L.7nc: ^107:6^ Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, et super omnem terram glória tua: * ut liberéntur dilécti tui.
L.7nd: ^107:7^ Salvum fac déxtera tua, et exáudi me: * Deus locútus est in sancto suo:
L.7nf: ^107:8^ Exsultábo, et dívidam Síchimam, * et convállem tabernaculórum dimétiar.
L.7ni: ^107:9^ Meus est Gálaad, et meus est Manásses: * et Éphraim suscéptio cápitis mei.
L.7mt: ^107:10^ Juda rex meus: * Moab lebes spei meæ.
L.7mr: ^107:10^ In Idumǽam exténdam calceaméntum meum: * mihi alienígenæ amíci facti sunt.
L.7mv: ^107:11^ Quis dedúcet me in civitátem munítam? * quis dedúcet me usque in Idumǽam?
L.7mx: ^107:12^ Nonne tu, Deus, qui repulísti nos, * et non exíbis, Deus, in virtútibus nostris?
L.7mz: ^107:13^ Da nobis auxílium de tribulatióne: * quia vana salus hóminis.
L.7n1: ^107:14^ In Deo faciémus virtútem: * et ipse ad níhilum dedúcet inimícos nostros.
L.7n3: ^107:2^ My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and will give praise, with my glory.
L.7n5: ^107:3^ Arise, my glory; arise, psaltery and harp * I will arise in the morning early.
L.7n8: ^107:4^ I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: * and I will sing unto thee among the nations.
L.7n9: ^107:5^ For thy mercy is great above the heavens: * and thy truth even unto the clouds.
L.7nb: ^107:6^ Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, and thy glory over all the earth: * that thy beloved may be delivered.
L.7ne: ^107:7^ Save with thy right hand and hear me. * God hath spoken in his holiness.
L.7ng: ^107:8^ I will rejoice, and I will divide Sichem * and I will mete out the vale of tabernacles.
L.7nh: ^107:9^ Galaad is mine: and Manasses is mine: * and Ephraim the protection of my head.
L.7ms: ^107:10^ Juda is my king: * Moab the pot of my hope.
L.7mu: ^107:10^ Over Edom I will stretch out my shoe: * the aliens are become my friends.
L.7mw: ^107:11^ Who will bring me into the strong city? * who will lead me into Edom?
L.7my: ^107:12^ Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? * and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our armies?
L.7n0: ^107:13^ O grant us help from trouble: * for vain is the help of man.
L.7n2: ^107:14^ Through God we shall do mightily: * and he will bring our enemies to nothing.
L.7on: ^108:2^ Deus, laudem meam ne tacúeris: * quia os peccatóris, et os dolósi super me apértum est.
L.7ot: ^108:3^ Locúti sunt advérsum me lingua dolósa, et sermónibus ódii circumdedérunt me: * et expugnavérunt me gratis.
L.7ow: ^108:4^ Pro eo ut me dilígerent, detrahébant mihi: * ego autem orábam.
L.7oy: ^108:5^ Et posuérunt advérsum me mala pro bonis: * et ódium pro dilectióne mea.
L.7oz: ^108:6^ Constítue super eum peccatórem: * et diábolus stet a dextris ejus.
L.7p1: ^108:7^ Cum judicátur, éxeat condemnátus: * et orátio ejus fiat in peccátum.
L.7p3: ^108:8^ Fiant dies ejus pauci: * et episcopátum ejus accípiat alter.
L.7p5: ^108:9^ Fiant fílii ejus órphani: * et uxor ejus vídua.
L.7nk: ^108:10^ Nutántes transferántur fílii ejus, et mendícent: * et eiciántur de habitatiónibus suis.
L.7nm: ^108:11^ Scrutétur fænerátor omnem substántiam ejus: * et dirípiant aliéni labóres ejus.
L.7no: ^108:12^ Non sit illi adjútor: * nec sit qui misereátur pupíllis ejus.
L.7np: ^108:13^ Fiant nati ejus in intéritum: * in generatióne una deleátur nomen ejus.
L.7nr: ^108:14^ In memóriam rédeat iníquitas patrum ejus in conspéctu Dómini: * et peccátum matris ejus non deleátur.
L.7nt: ^108:15^ Fiant contra Dóminum semper, et dispéreat de terra memória eórum: * pro eo quod non est recordátus fácere misericórdiam.
L.7nw: ^108:17^ Et persecútus est hóminem ínopem, et mendícum, * et compúnctum corde mortificáre.
L.7nz: ^108:18^ Et diléxit maledictiónem, et véniet ei: * et nóluit benedictiónem, et elongábitur ab eo.
L.7o0: ^108:18^ Et índuit maledictiónem sicut vestiméntum, * et intrávit sicut aqua in interióra ejus, et sicut óleum in óssibus ejus.
L.7o1: ^108:19^ Fiat ei sicut vestiméntum, quo operítur: * et sicut zona, qua semper præcíngitur.
L.7o3: ^108:20^ Hoc opus eórum, qui détrahunt mihi apud Dóminum: * et qui loquúntur mala advérsus ánimam meam.
L.7o6: ^108:21^ Et tu, Dómine, Dómine, fac mecum propter nomen tuum: * quia suávis est misericórdia tua.
L.7o8: ^108:22^ Líbera me quia egénus, et pauper ego sum: * et cor meum conturbátum est intra me.
L.7oa: ^108:23^ Sicut umbra cum declínat, ablátus sum: * et excússus sum sicut locústæ.
L.7ob: ^108:24^ Génua mea infirmáta sunt a jejúnio: * et caro mea immutáta est propter óleum.
L.7oe: ^108:25^ Et ego factus sum oppróbrium illis: * vidérunt me, et movérunt cápita sua.
L.7og: ^108:26^ Ádjuva me, Dómine, Deus meus: * salvum me fac secúndum misericórdiam tuam.
L.7oi: ^108:27^ Et sciant quia manus tua hæc: * et tu, Dómine, fecísti eam.
L.7oj: ^108:28^ Maledícent illi, et tu benedíces: * qui insúrgunt in me, confundántur: servus autem tuus lætábitur.
L.7ol: ^108:29^ Induántur qui détrahunt mihi, pudóre: * et operiántur sicut diplóide confusióne sua.
L.7op: ^108:30^ Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo: * et in médio multórum laudábo eum.
L.7os: ^108:31^ Quia ástitit a dextris páuperis, * ut salvam fáceret a persequéntibus ánimam meam.
L.xvf: ^Ant.^ Confitébor Dómino nimis in ore meo.
L.7oo: ^108:2^ God, be not thou silent in my praise: * for the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful man is opened against me.
L.7ou: ^108:3^ They have spoken against me with deceitful tongues; and they have compassed me about with words of hatred; * and have fought against me without cause.
L.7ov: ^108:4^ Instead of making me a return of love, they detracted me: * but I gave myself to prayer.
L.7ox: ^108:5^ And they repaid me evil for good: * and hatred for my love.
L.7p0: ^108:6^ Set thou the sinner over him: * and may the devil stand at his right hand.
L.7p2: ^108:7^ When he is judged, may he go out condemned; * and may his prayer be turned to sin.
L.7p4: ^108:8^ May his days be few: * and his bishopric let another take.
L.7p6: ^108:9^ May his children be fatherless, * and his wife a widow.
L.7nj: ^108:10^ Let his children be carried about vagabonds, and beg; * and let them be cast out of their dwellings.
L.7nl: ^108:11^ May the usurer search all his substance: * and let strangers plunder his labours.
L.7nn: ^108:12^ May there be none to help him: * nor none to pity his fatherless offspring.
L.7nq: ^108:13^ May his posterity be cut off; * in one generation may his name be blotted out.
L.7ns: ^108:14^ May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered in the sight of the Lord: * and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
L.7nu: ^108:15^ May they be before the Lord continually, and let the memory of them perish from the earth: * because he remembered not to shew mercy,
L.7nv: ^108:17^ But persecuted the poor man and the beggar; * and the broken in heart, to put him to death.
L.7nx: ^108:18^ And he loved cursing, and it shall come unto him: * and he would not have blessing, and it shall be far from him.
L.7ny: ^108:18^ And he put on cursing, like a garment: * and it went in like water into his entrails, and like oil in his bones.
L.7o2: ^108:19^ May it be unto him like a garment which covereth him; * and like a girdle with which he is girded continually.
L.7o4: ^108:20^ This is the work of them who detract me before the Lord; * and who speak evils against my soul.
L.7o5: ^108:21^ But thou, O Lord, do with me for thy name’s sake: * because thy mercy is sweet.
L.7o7: ^108:22^ Do thou deliver me, for I am poor and needy, * and my heart is troubled within me.
L.7o9: ^108:23^ I am taken away like the shadow when it declineth: * and I am shaken off as locusts.
L.7oc: ^108:24^ My knees are weakened through fasting: * and my flesh is changed for oil.
L.7od: ^108:25^ And I am become a reproach to them: * they saw me and they shaked their heads.
L.7of: ^108:26^ Help me, O Lord my God; * save me according to thy mercy.
L.7oh: ^108:27^ And let them know that this is thy hand: * and that thou, O Lord, hast done it.
L.7ok: ^108:28^ They will curse and thou wilt bless: * let them that rise up against me be confounded: but thy servant shall rejoice.
L.7om: ^108:29^ Let them that detract me be clothed with shame: * and let them be covered with their confusion as with a double cloak.
L.7oq: ^108:30^ I will give great thanks to the Lord with my mouth: * and in the midst of many I will praise him.
L.7or: ^108:31^ Because he hath stood at the right hand of the poor, * to save my soul from persecutors.
L.ygx: ^Ant.^ I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth.
L.xbm: ^Absolutio.^ Précibus et méritis beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis et ómnium Sanctórum, perdúcat nos Dóminus ad regna cælórum.
L.xbp: ^Absolution.^ May the prayers and merits of blessed Mary ever Virgin and all the Saints bring us to the kingdom of heaven.
L.gtz: ^Ant.^ O Holy Mother of God, thou art become beautiful.
L.9sw: ^℣.^ Qui natus es de María Vírgine.
L.80u: ^143:1^ Benedíctus ^‡^ Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
L.80v: ^143:1^ Blessed be ^‡^ the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.
L.94j: ^Ant.^ Blessed be the Lord my God.
L.81i: ^144:1^ Exaltábo te, Deus meus, rex: * et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
L.81p: ^144:2^ Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: * et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
L.81r: ^144:3^ Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
L.81t: ^144:4^ Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: * et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
L.81u: ^144:5^ Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: * et mirabília tua narrábunt.
L.81x: ^144:6^ Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: * et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
L.81y: ^144:7^ Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: * et justítia tua exsultábunt.
L.820: ^144:8^ Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * pátiens, et multum miséricors.
L.822: ^144:9^ Suávis Dóminus univérsis: * et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
L.80w: ^144:10^ Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: * et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
L.80y: ^144:11^ Glóriam regni tui dicent: * et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
L.811: ^144:12^ Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: * et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
L.813: ^144:13^ Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: * et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
L.812: ^144:13^ Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
L.817: ^144:14^ Állevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: * et érigit omnes elísos.
L.819: ^144:15^ Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: * et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
L.81b: ^144:16^ Áperis tu manum tuam: * et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
L.81c: ^144:17^ Justus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
L.81e: ^144:18^ Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: * ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
L.81h: ^144:19^ Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: * et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet: et salvos fáciet eos.
L.81k: ^144:20^ Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: * et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
L.81m: ^144:21^ Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: * et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto ejus in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
L.z6b: ^Ant.^ Per síngulos dies benedícam te Dómine.
L.81j: ^144:1^ I will extol thee, O God my king: * and I will bless thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
L.81o: ^144:2^ Every day will I bless thee: * and I will praise thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
L.81q: ^144:3^ Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: * and of his greatness there is no end.
L.81s: ^144:4^ Generation and generation shall praise thy works: * and they shall declare thy power.
L.81v: ^144:5^ They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of thy holiness: * and shall tell thy wondrous works.
L.81w: ^144:6^ And they shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: * and shall declare thy greatness.
L.81z: ^144:7^ They shall publish the memory of the abundance of thy sweetness: * and shall rejoice in thy justice.
L.821: ^144:8^ The Lord is gracious and merciful: * patient and plenteous in mercy.
L.823: ^144:9^ The Lord is sweet to all: * and his tender mercies are over all his works.
L.80x: ^144:10^ Let all thy works, O Lord, praise thee: * and let thy saints bless thee.
L.80z: ^144:11^ They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom: * and shall tell of thy power:
L.810: ^144:12^ To make thy might known to the sons of men: * and the glory of the magnificence of thy kingdom.
L.815: ^144:13^ Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: * and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.
L.814: ^144:13^ The Lord is faithful in all his words: * and holy in all his works.
L.816: ^144:14^ The Lord lifteth up all that fall: * and setteth up all that are cast down.
L.818: ^144:15^ The eyes of all hope in thee, O Lord: * and thou givest them meat in due season.
L.81a: ^144:16^ Thou openest thy hand, * and fillest with blessing every living creature.
L.81d: ^144:17^ The Lord is just in all his ways: * and holy in all his works.
L.81f: ^144:18^ The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him: * to all that call upon him in truth.
L.81g: ^144:19^ He will do the will of them that fear him: * and he will hear their prayer, and save them.
L.81l: ^144:20^ The Lord keepeth all them that love him; * but all the wicked he will destroy.
L.81n: ^144:21^ My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: * and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.
L.xyq: ^Ant.^ Day by day I shall bless thee, O Lord.
L.826: ^145:2^ Lauda, ánima mea, Dóminum, laudábo Dóminum in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo quámdiu fúero.
L.827: ^145:2^ Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
L.82a: ^145:4^ Exíbit spíritus ejus, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
L.82c: ^145:5^ Beátus, cujus Deus Jacob adjútor ejus, spes ejus in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
L.82f: ^145:7^ Qui custódit veritátem in sǽculum, facit judícium injúriam patiéntibus: * dat escam esuriéntibus.
L.82e: ^145:7^ Dóminus solvit compedítos: * Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
L.82i: ^145:8^ Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit justos.
L.82k: ^145:9^ Dóminus custódit ádvenas, pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
L.824: ^145:10^ Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
L.yms: ^Ant.^ Laudábo Deum meum in vita mea.
L.828: ^145:2^ Praise the Lord, O my soul, in my life I will praise the Lord: * I will sing to my God as long as I shall be.
L.829: ^145:2^ Put not your trust in princes: * in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.
L.82b: ^145:4^ His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.
L.82d: ^145:5^ Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, whose hope is in the Lord his God: * who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.
L.82h: ^145:7^ Who keepeth truth for ever: who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: * who giveth food to the hungry.
L.82g: ^145:7^ The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * the Lord enlighteneth the blind.
L.82j: ^145:8^ The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down: * the Lord loveth the just.
L.82l: ^145:9^ The Lord keepeth the strangers, he will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners he will destroy.
L.825: ^145:10^ The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.
L.ygp: ^Ant.^ I shall praise my God all the days of my life.
L.82q: ^146:1^ Laudáte Dóminum quóniam bonus est psalmus: * Deo nostro sit jucúnda, decóraque laudátio.
L.82t: ^146:2^ Ædíficans Jerúsalem Dóminus: * dispersiónes Israélis congregábit.
L.82u: ^146:3^ Qui sanat contrítos corde: * et álligat contritiónes eórum.
L.82w: ^146:4^ Qui númerat multitúdinem stellárum: * et ómnibus eis nómina vocat.
L.82z: ^146:5^ Magnus Dóminus noster, et magna virtus ejus: * et sapiéntiæ ejus non est númerus.
L.830: ^146:6^ Suscípiens mansuétos Dóminus: * humílians autem peccatóres usque ad terram.
L.832: ^146:7^ Præcínite Dómino in confessióne: * psállite Deo nostro in cíthara.
L.835: ^146:8^ Qui óperit cælum núbibus: * et parat terræ plúviam.
L.834: ^146:8^ Qui prodúcit in móntibus fænum: * et herbam servitúti hóminum.
L.838: ^146:9^ Qui dat juméntis escam ipsórum: * et pullis corvórum invocántibus eum.
L.82n: ^146:10^ Non in fortitúdine equi voluntátem habébit: * nec in tíbiis viri beneplácitum erit ei.
L.82o: ^146:11^ Beneplácitum est Dómino super timéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia ejus.
L.82r: ^146:1^ Praise ye the Lord, because psalm is good: * to our God be joyful and comely praise.
L.82s: ^146:2^ The Lord buildeth up Jerusalem: * he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.
L.82v: ^146:3^ Who healeth the broken of heart, * and bindeth up their bruises.
L.82x: ^146:4^ Who telleth the number of the stars: * and calleth them all by their names.
L.82y: ^146:5^ Great is our Lord, and great is his power: * and of his wisdom there is no number.
L.831: ^146:6^ The Lord lifteth up the meek, * and bringeth the wicked down even to the ground.
L.833: ^146:7^ Sing ye to the Lord with praise: * sing to our God upon the harp.
L.836: ^146:8^ Who covereth the heaven with clouds, * and prepareth rain for the earth.
L.837: ^146:8^ Who maketh grass to grow on the mountains, * and herbs for the service of men.
L.839: ^146:9^ Who giveth to beasts their food: * and to the young ravens that call upon him.
L.82m: ^146:10^ He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: * nor take pleasure in the legs of a man.
L.82p: ^146:11^ The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him: * and in them that hope in his mercy.
L.zuy: ^Ant.^ To our God be joyful and fitting praise.
L.skn: ^147:1^ Lauda, ^‡^ Jerúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
L.ysj: ^Ant.^ May praise to our God be joyful.
L.779: O Altitúdo divitiárum sapiéntiæ, et sciéntiæ Dei, quam incomprehensibília sunt judícia ejus, et investigábiles viæ ejus!
L.78a: O the depth of the riches of the wisdom and of the knowledge of God! How incomprehensible are his judgments, and how unsearchable his ways!
L.q2n: Salve, sancta parens, eníxa puérpera Regem: qui cælum terrámque regit in sǽcula sæculórum.
L.ni7: Hail, holy Mother, who in childbirth brought forth the King Who rules heaven and earth world without end.
L.llh: Ab inítio et ante sǽcula creáta sum, et usque ad futúrum sǽculum non désinam, et in habitatióne sancta coram ipso ministrávi. Et sic in Sion firmáta sum, et in civitáte sanctificáta simíliter requiévi, et in Jerúsalem potéstas mea. Et radicávi in pópulo honorificáto, et in parte Dei mei heréditas illíus, et in plenitúdine sanctórum deténtio mea.
L.m57: Before all ages, in the beginning, He created me, and through all ages I shall not cease to be. In the holy Tent I ministered before Him, and in Sion I fixed my abode. Thus in the chosen city He has given me rest, in Jerusalem is my domain. I have struck root among the glorious people, in the portion of my God, His heritage, and my abode is in the full assembly of Saints.
L.ny6: In illo témpore: Loquénte Jesu ad turbas, extóllens vocem quædam múlier de turba, dixit illi: Beátus venter, qui te portávit, et úbera, quæ suxísti. At ille dixit: Quinímmo beáti, qui áudiunt verbum Dei, et custódiunt illud.
L.aqs: At that time, as Jesus was speaking to the multitudes, a certain woman from the crowd lifted up her voice and said to Him, Blessed is the womb that bore You, and the breasts that nursed You. But He said, Rather, blessed are they who hear the word of God and keep it.
L.r1k: Vere dignum et justum est, æquum et salutáre, nos tibi semper et ubíque grátias ágere: Dómine sancte, Pater omnípotens, ætérne Deus: Et te in veneratione beátæ Maríæ semper Vírginis collaudáre, benedícere et prædicáre. Quæ et Unigénitum tuum Sancti Spíritus obumbratióne concépit: et, virginitátis glória permanénte, lumen ætérnum mundo effúdit, Jesum Christum, Dóminum nostrum. Per quem majestátem tuam laudant Angeli, adórant Dominatiónes, tremunt Potestátes. Cæli cælorúmque Virtútes ac beáta Séraphim sócia exsultatióne concélebrant. Cum quibus et nostras voces ut admítti jubeas, deprecámur, súpplici confessióne dicéntes:
L.o6d: It is truly meet and just, right and for our salvation, that we should at all times, and in all places, give thanks unto Thee, O holy Lord, Father almighty, everlasting God: and that we should praise and bless, and proclaim Thee, in the veneration of the Blessed Mary, ever-Virgin: Who also conceived Thine only-begotten Son by the overshadowing of the Holy Ghost, and the glory of her virginity still abiding, gave forth to the world the everlasting Light, Jesus Christ our Lord. Through whom the Angels praise Thy Majesty, the Dominations worship it, and the Powers stand in awe. The Heavens and the heavenly hosts together with the blessed Seraphim in triumphant chorus unite to celebrate it. Together with these we entreat Thee that Thou mayest bid our voices also to be admitted while we say with lowly praise:
L.m6w: Beáta víscera Maríæ Vírginis, quæ portavérunt ætérni Patris Fílium.
L.m89: Blessed is the womb of the Virgin Mary, which bore the Son of the eternal Father.
L.zdz: ^Ant.^ Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling before Him.
L.ze0: ^Ant.^ Servíte Dómino in timóre, et exsultáte ei cum tremóre.
L.wzy: ^9:2^ Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * narrábo ómnia mirabília tua.
L.x0p: ^9:3^ Lætábor et exsultábo in te: * psallam nómini tuo, Altíssime.
L.x0q: ^9:4^ In converténdo inimícum meum retrórsum: * infirmabúntur, et períbunt a fácie tua.
L.x0t: ^9:5^ Quóniam fecísti judícium meum et causam meam: * sedísti super thronum, qui júdicas justítiam.
L.x0u: ^9:6^ Increpásti gentes, et périit ímpius: * nomen eórum delésti in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
L.x0w: ^9:7^ Inimíci defecérunt frámeæ in finem: * et civitátes eórum destruxísti.
L.x0x: ^9:7^ Périit memória eórum cum sónitu: * et Dóminus in ætérnum pérmanet.
L.x11: ^9:8^ Parávit in judício thronum suum: * et ipse judicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, judicábit pópulos in justítia.
L.wyr: ^9:10^ Et factus est Dóminus refúgium páuperi: * adjútor in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne.
L.wyt: ^9:11^ Et sperent in te qui novérunt nomen tuum: * quóniam non dereliquísti quæréntes te, Dómine.
L.wyu: ^9:12^ Psállite Dómino, qui hábitat in Sion: * annuntiáte inter gentes stúdia ejus:
L.wyx: ^9:13^ Quóniam requírens sánguinem eórum recordátus est: * non est oblítus clamórem páuperum.
L.wyz: ^9:14^ Miserére mei, Dómine: * vide humilitátem meam de inimícis meis.
L.wz0: ^9:15^ Qui exáltas me de portis mortis, * ut annúntiem omnes laudatiónes tuas in portis fíliæ Sion.
L.wz2: ^9:16^ Exsultábo in salutári tuo: * infíxæ sunt gentes in intéritu, quem fecérunt.
L.wz4: ^9:16^ In láqueo isto, quem abscondérunt, * comprehénsus est pes eórum.
L.wz6: ^9:17^ Cognoscétur Dóminus judícia fáciens: * in opéribus mánuum suárum comprehénsus est peccátor.
L.wz8: ^9:18^ Convertántur peccatóres in inférnum, * omnes gentes quæ obliviscúntur Deum.
L.wzb: ^9:19^ Quóniam non in finem oblívio erit páuperis: * patiéntia páuperum non períbit in finem.
L.wzd: ^9:20^ Exsúrge, Dómine, non confortétur homo: * judicéntur gentes in conspéctu tuo.
L.wzf: ^9:21^ Constítue, Dómine, legislatórem super eos: * ut sciant gentes quóniam hómines sunt.
L.wzg: ^9:22^ Ut quid, Dómine, recessísti longe, * déspicis in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne?
L.wzi: ^9:23^ Dum supérbit ímpius, incénditur pauper: * comprehendúntur in consíliis quibus cógitant.
L.wzl: ^9:24^ Quóniam laudátur peccátor in desidériis ánimæ suæ: * et iníquus benedícitur.
L.wzm: ^9:25^ Exacerbávit Dóminum peccátor, * secúndum multitúdinem iræ suæ non quæret.
L.wzq: ^9:26^ Non est Deus in conspéctu ejus: * inquinátæ sunt viæ illíus in omni témpore.
L.wzo: ^9:26^ Auferúntur judícia tua a fácie ejus: * ómnium inimicórum suórum dominábitur.
L.wzs: ^9:27^ Dixit enim in corde suo: * Non movébor a generatióne in generatiónem sine malo.
L.wzu: ^9:28^ Cujus maledictióne os plenum est, et amaritúdine, et dolo: * sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.
L.wzx: ^9:29^ Sedet in insídiis cum divítibus in occúltis: * ut interfíciat innocéntem.
L.x03: ^9:30^ Óculi ejus in páuperem respíciunt: * insidiátur in abscóndito, quasi leo in spelúnca sua.
L.x02: ^9:30^ Insidiátur ut rápiat páuperem: * rápere páuperem, dum áttrahit eum.
L.x05: ^9:31^ In láqueo suo humiliábit eum: * inclinábit se, et cadet, cum dominátus fúerit páuperum.
L.x06: ^9:32^ Dixit enim in corde suo: Oblítus est Deus, * avértit fáciem suam ne vídeat in finem.
L.x09: ^9:33^ Exsúrge, Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua: * ne obliviscáris páuperum.
L.x0a: ^9:34^ Propter quid irritávit ímpius Deum? * dixit enim in corde suo: Non requíret.
L.x0f: ^9:35^ Vides quóniam tu labórem et dolórem consíderas: * ut tradas eos in manus tuas.
L.x0d: ^9:35^ Tibi derelíctus est pauper: * órphano tu eris adjútor.
L.x0h: ^9:36^ Cóntere brácchium peccatóris et malígni: * quærétur peccátum illíus, et non inveniétur.
L.x0i: ^9:37^ Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * períbitis, gentes, de terra illíus.
L.x0k: ^9:38^ Desidérium páuperum exaudívit Dóminus: * præparatiónem cordis eórum audívit auris tua.
L.x0m: ^9:39^ Judicáre pupíllo et húmili, * ut non appónat ultra magnificáre se homo super terram.
L.wzz: ^9:2^ I will give praise to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * I will relate all thy wonders.
L.x0o: ^9:3^ I will be glad and rejoice in thee: * I will sing to thy name, O thou most high.
L.x0r: ^9:4^ When my enemy shall be turned back: * they shall be weakened and perish before thy face.
L.x0s: ^9:5^ For thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: * thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.
L.x0v: ^9:6^ Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: * thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.
L.x0y: ^9:7^ The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: * and their cities thou hast destroyed.
L.x0z: ^9:7^ Their memory hath perished with a noise. * But the Lord remaineth for ever.
L.x10: ^9:8^ He hath prepared his throne in judgment: * And he shall judge the world in equity, he shall judge the people in justice.
L.wyq: ^9:10^ And the Lord is become a refuge for the poor: * a helper in due time in tribulation.
L.wys: ^9:11^ And let them trust in thee who know thy name: * for thou hast not forsaken them that seek thee, O Lord.
L.wyv: ^9:12^ Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: * declare his ways among the Gentiles.
L.wyw: ^9:13^ For requiring their blood he hath remembered them: * he hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.
L.wyy: ^9:14^ Have mercy on me, O Lord: * see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.
L.wz1: ^9:15^ Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death, * that I may declare all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.
L.wz3: ^9:16^ I will rejoice in thy salvation: * the Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they have prepared.
L.wz5: ^9:16^ Their foot hath been taken * in the very snare which they hid.
L.wz7: ^9:17^ The Lord shall be known when he executeth judgments: * the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.
L.wz9: ^9:18^ The wicked shall be turned into hell, * all the nations that forget God.
L.wza: ^9:19^ For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: * the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.
L.wzc: ^9:20^ Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: * let the Gentiles be judged in thy sight.
L.wze: ^9:21^ Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: * that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.
L.wzh: ^9:22^ Why, O Lord, hast thou retired afar off? * why dost thou slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?
L.wzj: ^9:23^ Whilst the wicked man is proud, the poor is set on fire: * they are caught in the counsels which they devise.
L.wzk: ^9:24^ For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul: * and the unjust man is blessed.
L.wzn: ^9:25^ The sinner hath provoked the Lord, * according to the multitude of his wrath he will not seek him.
L.wzp: ^9:26^ God is not before his eyes: * his ways are filthy at all times.
L.wzr: ^9:26^ Thy judgments are removed from his sight: * he shall rule over all his enemies.
L.wzt: ^9:27^ For he hath said in his heart: * I shall not be moved from generation to generation, and shall be without evil.
L.wzv: ^9:28^ His mouth is full of cursing, and of bitterness, and of deceit: * under his tongue are labour and sorrow.
L.wzw: ^9:29^ He sitteth in ambush with the rich, in private places, * that he may kill the innocent.
L.x01: ^9:30^ His eyes are upon the poor man: * he lieth in wait, in secret, like a lion in his den.
L.x00: ^9:30^ He lieth in ambush, that he may catch the poor man: * so catch the poor, whilst he draweth him to him.
L.x04: ^9:31^ In his net he will bring him down, * he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.
L.x07: ^9:32^ For he hath said in his heart: God hath forgotten, * he hath turned away his face, not to see to the end.
L.x08: ^9:33^ Arise, O Lord God, let thy hand be exalted: * forget not the poor.
L.x0b: ^9:34^ Wherefore hath the wicked provoked God? * for he hath said in his heart: He will not require it.
L.x0c: ^9:35^ Thou seest it, for thou considerest labour and sorrow: * that thou mayst deliver them into thy hands.
L.x0e: ^9:35^ To thee is the poor man left: * thou wilt be a helper to the orphan.
L.x0g: ^9:36^ Break thou the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: * his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.
L.x0j: ^9:37^ The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: * ye Gentiles shall perish from his land.
L.x0l: ^9:38^ The Lord hath heard the desire of the poor: * thy ear hath heard the preparation of their heart.
L.x0n: ^9:39^ To judge for the fatherless and for the humble, * that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.
L.xzs: ^Ant.^ Deus judex justus fortis et longánimus, numquid irascétur per síngulos dies.
L.yak: ^Ant.^ God is a righteous judge strong, and patient is He not provoked every day?
L.ztw: ^Ant.^ Thou shalt keep us, O Lord, and preserve us.
L.s3v: ^12:1^ Úsquequo, Dómine, obliviscéris me in finem? * Úsquequo avértis fáciem tuam a me?
L.s3x: ^12:2^ Quámdiu ponam consília in ánima mea, * dolórem in corde meo per diem?
L.s3z: ^12:3^ Úsquequo exaltábitur inimícus meus super me? * réspice, et exáudi me, Dómine, Deus meus.
L.s41: ^12:4^ Illúmina óculos meos ne umquam obdórmiam in morte: * nequándo dicat inimícus meus: Præválui advérsus eum.
L.s42: ^12:5^ Qui tríbulant me, exsultábunt si motus fúero: * ego autem in misericórdia tua sperávi.
L.s44: ^12:6^ Exsultábit cor meum in salutári tuo: cantábo Dómino qui bona tríbuit mihi: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
L.s3u: ^12:1^ How long, O Lord, wilt thou forget me unto the end? * how long dost thou turn away thy face from me?
L.s3w: ^12:2^ How long shall I take counsels in my soul, * sorrow in my heart all the day?
L.s3y: ^12:3^ How long shall my enemy be exalted over me? * Consider, and hear me, O Lord my God.
L.s40: ^12:4^ Enlighten my eyes that I never sleep in death: * lest at any time my enemy say: I have prevailed against him.
L.s43: ^12:5^ They that trouble me will rejoice when I am moved: * but I have trusted in thy mercy.
L.s45: ^12:6^ My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation: I will sing to the Lord, who giveth me good things: * yea, I will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.
L.scl: ^13:1^ Dixit insípiens in corde suo: * non est Deus.
L.sck: ^13:1^ Corrúpti sunt, et abominábiles facti sunt in stúdiis suis: * non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
L.sco: ^13:2^ Dóminus de cælo prospéxit super fílios hóminum, * ut vídeat si est intéllegens, aut requírens Deum.
L.scs: ^13:3^ Omnes declinavérunt, simul inútiles facti sunt: * non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
L.scu: ^13:3^ Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum: linguis suis dolóse agébant * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
L.sct: ^13:3^ Quorum os maledictióne et amaritúdine plenum est: * velóces pedes eórum ad effundéndum sánguinem.
L.scq: ^13:3^ Contrítio et infelícitas in viis eórum, et viam pacis non cognovérunt: * non est timor Dei ante óculos eórum.
L.scy: ^13:4^ Nonne cognóscent omnes qui operántur iniquitátem, * qui dévorant plebem meam sicut escam panis?

L.8bj: ^34:18^ Confitébor tibi in ecclésia magna, * in pópulo gravi laudábo te.

L.8cb: ^34:3^ Bring out the sword, and shut up the way against them that persecute me: * say to my soul: I am thy salvation.
L.8cf: ^34:4^ Let them be confounded and ashamed * that seek after my soul.
L.8cg: ^34:4^ Let them be turned back and be confounded * that devise against me.
L.8ci: ^34:5^ Let them become as dust before the wind: * and let the Angel of the Lord straiten them.
L.8ck: ^34:6^ Let their way become dark and slippery; * and let the Angel of the Lord pursue them.

L.8cp: ^34:9^ But my soul shall rejoice in the Lord; * and shall be delighted in his salvation.

L.8bl: ^34:19^ Let not them that are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: * who have hated me without cause, and wink with the eyes.
L.8bp: ^34:20^ For they spoke indeed peaceably to me; * and speaking in the anger of the earth they devised guile.
L.8br: ^34:21^ And they opened their mouth wide against me; * they said: Well done, well done, our eyes have seen it.
L.8bt: ^34:22^ Thou hast seen, O Lord, be not thou silent: * O Lord, depart not from me.
L.8bv: ^34:23^ Arise, and be attentive to my judgment: * to my cause, my God, and my Lord.
L.8bx: ^34:24^ Judge me, O Lord my God according to thy justice, * and let them not rejoice over me.
L.8bz: ^34:25^ Let them not say in their hearts: It is well, it is well, to our mind: * neither let them say: We have swallowed him up.
L.8c4: ^34:26^ Let them blush: and be ashamed together, * who rejoice at my evils.
L.8c3: ^34:26^ Let them be clothed with confusion and shame, * who speak great things against me.
L.8c6: ^34:27^ Let them rejoice and be glad, who are well pleased with my justice, * and let them say always: The Lord be magnified, who delights in the peace of his servant.
L.8c7: ^34:28^ And my tongue shall meditate thy justice, * thy praise all the day long.
